sections.title: I Turned Claude Into a 24/7 Trader

items.q: What should you remember about **Opus 4.7 + routines = 24/7 agent**?
items.a: **full agentic loop on a** schedule; cheaper than equivalent API-only cron orchestration at Nate's usage level.

items.q: What should you remember about **Genetic financial analysis ≠ day trading**?
items.a: **benchmark rewards fundamentals/thesis writing;** maps to long-term or swing strategies, not candlestick timing.

items.q: What should you remember about **Five weekday crons**?
items.a: **pre-market (research, draft ideas), market open (execute** + 10% trailing stops), midday (cut −7% losers, tighten winners), close (EOD summary), Friday weekly review.

items.q: What should you remember about **Start paper, phase up**?
items.a: **like teaching a kid to ride a** bike; guardrails before autonomy (max % per position, daily loss cap, no options, position limits).

items.q: What should you remember about **Env var names must match exactly**?
items.a: **cloud environment keys (e.g. ALPACA_API_SECRET) must** appear letter-for-letter in prompts; agent defaulted to .env and failed until fixed.

items.q: What should you remember about **Never commit secrets**?
items.a: rotate keys found in migrated OpenClaw templates; store Alpaca, Perplexity, ClickUp keys in Claude Desktop **cloud environment** settings only.

items.q: What should you remember about **Files = personality + discipline**?
items.a: **not just memory; orchestrate which** files each routine reads (strategy, trade log, CLAUDE.md ~156 lines for Bull).

items.q: What should you remember about **Watch every run early**?
items.a: **read conversation history, tweak prompts** and context files; agent suggests skill updates in daily insights.

items.q: What should you remember about **Context reset before routine design**?
items.a: **/clear with pasted session** summary after migration to avoid rot before planning crons.

items.q: What should you remember about **Perplexity over native web search**?
items.a: **preferred research API; keys** from env vars at runtime.
